시편-54-1.title: 시편 54장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-1.exegesis: 5. Instead of assurances of God's presence with the pious, and a complaint of the wicked, Psa 14:5 , 6 portrays the ruin of the latter, whose "bones" even "are scattered" (compare Psa 141:7 ), and who are put to shame as contemptuously rejected of God.
시편-54-1.theologicalNote: 5. Instead of assurances of God's presence with the pious, and a complaint of the wicked, Psa 14:5 , 6 portrays the ruin of the latter, whose "bones" even "are scattered" (compare Psa 141:7 ), and who are put to shame as contemptuously rejected of God.

시편-54-2.title: 시편 54장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-2.exegesis: PSALM 54 Psa 54:1-7 . See on Psa 4:1 , title; Psa 32:1 , title; for the history, see 1Sa 23:19 , 29 ; 26:1-25 . After an earnest cry for help, the Psalmist promises praise in the assurance of a hearing. 1. by thy name-- ( Psa 5:11 ), specially, power. judge me-- as in Psa 7:8 ; 26:1 .
시편-54-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 54 Psa 54:1-7 . See on Psa 4:1 , title; Psa 32:1 , title; for the history, see 1Sa 23:19 , 29 ; 26:1-25 . After an earnest cry for help, the Psalmist promises praise in the assurance of a hearing. 1. by thy name-- ( Psa 5:11 ), specially, power. judge me-- as in Psa 7:8 ; 26:1 .

시편-54-4.title: 시편 54장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-4.exegesis: 3. strangers-- perhaps Ziphites. oppressors-- literally, "terrible ones" ( Is 13:11 ; 25:3 ). Such were Saul and his army. not set ... them-- acted as atheists, without God's fear (compare Psa 16:8 ).
시편-54-4.theologicalNote: 3. strangers-- perhaps Ziphites. oppressors-- literally, "terrible ones" ( Is 13:11 ; 25:3 ). Such were Saul and his army. not set ... them-- acted as atheists, without God's fear (compare Psa 16:8 ).

시편-54-5.title: 시편 54장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-5.exegesis: 4. (Compare Psa 30:10 ). with them-- on their side, and for me (compare Psa 46:11 ).
시편-54-5.theologicalNote: 4. (Compare Psa 30:10 ). with them-- on their side, and for me (compare Psa 46:11 ).

시편-54-6.title: 시편 54장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-6.exegesis: 5. He shall ... evil-- or, "Evil shall return on" ( Psa 7:16 ) my enemies or watchers, that is, to do me evil ( Psa 6:7 ). in thy truth-- Thy verified promise.
시편-54-6.theologicalNote: 5. He shall ... evil-- or, "Evil shall return on" ( Psa 7:16 ) my enemies or watchers, that is, to do me evil ( Psa 6:7 ). in thy truth-- Thy verified promise.

시편-54-7.title: 시편 54장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-54-7.exegesis: 6. I will freely, &c.-- or, present a freewill offering ( Le 7:16 ; Nu 15:3 ).
시편-54-7.theologicalNote: 6. I will freely, &c.-- or, present a freewill offering ( Le 7:16 ; Nu 15:3 ).
